chapter: Early bands and joining George Lewis
title: Trio with Bud Russel and the kazoo player
summary: Bud Russel heard him on Galvez Street and added bass, making a trio with a friend playing a strong kazoo.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played what: early band size and instrumentation

blocks.x: He played with them for several years and they left from there and he went on to Chicago. Well I knocked around different jobs with no particular bands and when Bud Russel came out and heard me one night, right a few blocks up here on Galvest Street on a Sunday night, brought his bass along. So that made us have three pieces and the boyfriend of ours used to play them kazooch. You could hardly tell if you was on about a couple blocks away you'd swear it was a trumpet.
Because he was short and fat and he had plenty of strong wind, strong lungs.
Is it something like the one that Noon has or different?
No, no, just one of them little short ones that you use.
Oh, the record kazoo, a little one.
The record kazooch that you use cigarette paper.
